tweet.text:
This Bad news for ChatGPT Plus users

We already had pretty limited usage to begin with and now OpenAI is moving toward a shared usage pool between ChatGPT and Codex

This means your ChatGPT and Codex usage will come from the same allowance, Unless OpenAI increases the overall limits significantly, this could make things even worse for Plus users

We really need more usage, not fewer ways to consume it
